settings/language.title: Language
settings/language.body: Interface language. 'System' follows the console setting.

settings/version.title: App version
settings/version.body: Current build. Tap seven times to unlock the Power User menu.

settings/enableThreadAffinity.title: Thread affinity
settings/enableThreadAffinity.body: Pin stream threads to specific CPU cores. Applies after a restart.

settings/holepunchRetry.title: Holepunch retry
settings/holepunchRetry.body: Retry NAT traversal when the first attempt fails.

settings/requestIdrOnFecFailure.title: Request IDR on FEC failure
settings/requestIdrOnFecFailure.body: Ask the console for a fresh keyframe when error-correction can't recover a frame.

settings/packetLossMax.title: Max packet loss
settings/packetLossMax.body: Upper packet-loss bound before the stream lowers quality to keep up.
